$description: Špijun UI copy, Croatian (hr) + English (en). Source: design canvas H·06–H·08 copy table (287 keys, asset f5a22c66…), plus strings visible in mock-ups that had no key (marked status=proposed). EN is the default locale (composeResources/values), HR in values-hr.

format.plurals: Use pluralStringResource. HR (CLDR): one · few · other (1, 21, 31… → one; 2–4, 22–24… → few; everything else → other). EN: one · other. Whole sentences are keyed — never concatenate a verb with a plural noun (the verb agrees: „je 1 špijun“, „su 3 špijuna“, „je 5 špijuna“).
format.names: Player names are user input: strings NEVER inflect them (no vocative/dative/genitive). e.g. „Dodaj telefon Luki“ → „Telefon ide: %1$s“; „Glasaj za Anu“ → „Glasaj · %1$s“; „Izbaci Anu“ → „Izbaci · %1$s“; „između Ane i Luke“ → „%1$s ili %2$s“.
format.gender: Nicknames carry no gender, so no gendered past participles about players: „Ana je izbačena“ → „Ana ispada iz igre“; „Povezan/a“ → „Na vezi“; „Dobrodošla natrag“ → „Opet si tu“; „Ispao si“ → „Izvan igre si“; stamp „IZBAČENA“ → „IZVAN IGRE“.
format.quotes: HR uses „…“ quotes, EN “…”. Apostrophe in EN is typographic ’. Ellipsis is the single character … .
format.caps: Keys whose value is in CAPS are labels (type token `label`, +8% tracking). Keep them uppercase in the resource; don't rely on textTransform for HR (ß-style issues don't apply, but consistency does).

home_tagline.hr: Jedna tajna riječ i špijun među vama.
home_tagline.en: One secret word, and a spy among you.

home_continue_label.note: Caps label; never shows role or word

mode_one_phone_desc.hr: Telefon kruži, svatko pogleda svoju kartu.
mode_one_phone_desc.en: Pass the phone; everyone looks at their own card.

mode_multi_desc.hr: Domaćin otvara sobu, ostali ulaze kodom ili QR-om.
mode_multi_desc.en: The host opens a room; others join with a code or QR.

mode_note.hr: Pravila su ista. Za drugi način treba internet.
mode_note.en: Same rules. The second mode needs internet.

setup_players_from_room.en: join with the code once you open the room · 3–12

setup_vote_app_hint.hr: Tajno glasanje — rezultat se vidi kad svi glasaju.
setup_vote_app_hint.en: Secret vote — results show once everyone has voted.

setup_privacy_hint.hr: U sobu putuje samo izvučena riječ, ne tvoj rječnik.
setup_privacy_hint.en: Only the drawn word goes to the room — never your dictionary.

setup_empty_pool.en: The selected categories have no words.

setup_offline.hr: Nema veze sa serverom. Igraš sa spremljenim rječnicima.
setup_offline.en: No connection to the server. Playing with saved dictionaries.

join_code_hint.hr: Upiši kod od 4 znaka s domaćinova ekrana.
join_code_hint.en: Enter the 4-character code from the host’s screen.

join_nick_hint.hr: Vide ga samo igrači u ovoj sobi.
join_nick_hint.en: Only players in this room see it.

join_err_not_found.hr: Soba %1$s ne postoji. Provjeri kod ili skeniraj QR.
join_err_not_found.en: Room %1$s doesn’t exist. Check the code or scan the QR.

join_err_nick_taken.hr: Netko u sobi već se zove %1$s.
join_err_nick_taken.en: Someone in the room is already called %1$s.

join_err_started_body.hr: Uđi kad krene sljedeća — kod ostaje isti.
join_err_started_body.en: Join when the next one starts — the code stays the same.

reveal_nobody_look.en: Make sure nobody else is looking.

reveal_spy_alone.hr: Sam si. Slušaj, blefiraj i ne odaj se.
reveal_spy_alone.en: You’re alone. Listen, bluff, don’t give yourself away.

reveal_starts_when_all.en: The discussion starts once everyone has looked.

round_vote_opens.hr: Kad vrijeme istekne, otvara se glasanje.
round_vote_opens.en: When time runs out, voting opens.

vote_secret.hr: Glas je tajan. Rezultat se vidi kad svi glasaju.
vote_secret.en: Your vote is secret. Results show once everyone has voted.

vote_locked.hr: Nakon potvrde glas se ne može promijeniti.
vote_locked.en: Once confirmed, your vote can’t be changed.

vote_close_hint.en: Closing counts only the votes already cast.

vote_pass_secret.hr: Glas je tajan — neka nitko ne gleda.
vote_pass_secret.en: Your vote is secret — don’t let anyone look.

vote_spectator_body.hr: Gledaš do kraja, ali ne glasaš. Ne odaj ništa — uloge se otkrivaju na kraju.
vote_spectator_body.en: You’re watching till the end but can’t vote. Don’t give anything away — roles are revealed at the end.

result_out_stamp.note: Stamp on the face-down card; gender-neutral

result_roles_end.hr: Uloge se otkrivaju na kraju igre.
result_roles_end.en: Roles are revealed at the end of the game.

result_tie_again_body.hr: Nitko ne ispada. Igra se nastavlja.
result_tie_again_body.en: Nobody’s out. The game goes on.

gameover_play_again_hint.hr: Iste postavke, nova riječ, nove uloge.
gameover_play_again_hint.en: Same settings, new word, new roles.

dict_local_hint.hr: Sprema se samo na ovaj telefon. U igru putuje samo izvučena riječ.
dict_local_hint.en: Saved only on this phone. Only the drawn word goes into a game.

dict_delete_body.hr: Sve kategorije i riječi trajno će se obrisati s ovog telefona.
dict_delete_body.en: All its categories and words will be permanently deleted from this phone.

dict_empty_title.en: No dictionaries of your own yet

dict_empty_body.hr: Napravi svoj s riječima vaše ekipe ili uvezi datoteku od prijatelja.
dict_empty_body.en: Make one with your group’s words, or import a file from a friend.

dict_readonly.hr: Ugrađeni rječnik ne možeš mijenjati. Kopiraj ga i uredi kopiju.
dict_readonly.en: Built-in dictionaries can’t be edited. Make a copy and edit that.

export_file_desc.en: Send the .json by message or email, or save it.

export_qr_desc.hr: Za nekoga tko sjedi pokraj tebe.
export_qr_desc.en: For someone sitting next to you.

export_too_big.en: Too big — about 80 words (2 KB) max.

export_qr_how.hr: Prijatelj otvara Špijun → Rječnici → Uvezi → Skeniraj.
export_qr_how.en: Your friend opens Špijun → Dictionaries → Import → Scan.

import_conflict.en: You already have “%1$s”. What would you like to do?

import_merge_desc.hr: Doda nove riječi, preskoči one koje već imaš.
import_merge_desc.en: Adds the new words and skips the ones you already have.

import_err_invalid_body.hr: Datoteka se ne može pročitati. Zamoli prijatelja da je ponovno izveze iz Špijuna.
import_err_invalid_body.en: The file can’t be read. Ask your friend to export it from Špijun again.

import_err_version.hr: Ova datoteka je iz novije verzije Špijuna — ažuriraj aplikaciju.
import_err_version.en: This file is from a newer version of Špijun — update the app.

import_err_empty.hr: Rječnik je prazan — nema što uvesti.
import_err_empty.en: The dictionary is empty — nothing to import.

scan_hint.hr: Sobe ili rječnika — prepoznat ćemo što je.
scan_hint.en: A room or a dictionary — we’ll work out which.

settings_reveal_tap_desc.hr: Karta se okrene i sama se vrati. Preporučeno.
settings_reveal_tap_desc.en: The card flips and turns back by itself. Recommended.

settings_reveal_hold_desc.hr: Vidi se samo dok držiš prst na karti.
settings_reveal_hold_desc.en: Visible only while your finger is on the card.

settings_autohide_desc.hr: Karta se sama okrene nakon %1$d sekundi, da tajna ne ostane na ekranu.
settings_autohide_desc.en: The card turns back after %1$d seconds so the secret never lingers.

settings_reduce_motion.hr: Uključeno je „Smanji pokrete“ — karta se pojavljuje bez okretanja i stol se ne vrti.
settings_reduce_motion.en: “Reduce Motion” is on — the card appears without flipping and the table doesn’t turn.

admin_body.hr: Unesi PIN za uređivanje ugrađenih rječnika. Izmjene vide svi igrači.
admin_body.en: Enter the PIN to edit built-in dictionaries. Every player sees the changes.

conn_reconnecting.hr: Ponovno spajanje… Igra se nastavlja, vraćamo te čim uhvatiš signal.
conn_reconnecting.en: Reconnecting… The game goes on; you’ll be back as soon as you have signal.

conn_card_saved.hr: Tvoja karta je spremljena na ovom telefonu.
conn_card_saved.en: Your card is saved on this phone.

conn_player_dropped_body.hr: Čekamo još %1$s. Ako ga izbaciš, ide među izbačene — uloga se otkriva tek na kraju.
conn_player_dropped_body.en: Waiting %1$s more. If you remove them they count as out — their role is still revealed only at the end.

conn_host_left_body.hr: Netko mora preuzeti vođenje da biste nastavili — uloge ostaju iste.
conn_host_left_body.en: Someone needs to take over to carry on — roles stay the same.

conn_removed.en: The host removed you from the game

conn_removed_body.hr: Možeš ući ponovno kad počne sljedeća igra, s istim kodom sobe.
conn_removed_body.en: You can rejoin when the next game starts, with the same room code.

conn_offline_body.hr: Za igru „svaki na svom telefonu“ treba veza. Na jednom telefonu možeš igrati i bez nje.
conn_offline_body.en: “Each on their own phone” needs a connection. One-phone play works without it.

conn_back_body.hr: Runda %1$d je još u tijeku. Ništa ti nije promaknulo.
conn_back_body.en: Round %1$d is still going. You haven’t missed anything.

quit_body.hr: Igra završava za sve igrače u sobi. Uloge i riječ neće se otkriti.
quit_body.en: The game ends for everyone in the room. Roles and the word won’t be revealed.

camera_body.hr: Koristimo je samo dok skeniraš kod sobe ili rječnika. Ništa se ne snima ni ne šalje.
camera_body.en: Used only while you scan a room or dictionary code. Nothing is recorded or sent.

a11y_card_hidden.hr: Karta za igrača %1$s. Dvaput dodirni za prikaz uloge.
a11y_card_hidden.en: Card for %1$s. Double-tap to show your role.

a11y_spy.en: Spy. You don’t know the word. Category: %1$s.

a11y_timer.note: Announced at full minutes, 30 s, 10 s, 0

a11y_sr_warning.hr: Uloga će se izgovoriti naglas. Stavi slušalice.
a11y_sr_warning.en: Your role will be read aloud. Put on headphones.
a11y_sr_warning.note: Before first reveal with a screen reader

a11y_knocked_out.hr: %1$s ispada. Uloge se otkrivaju na kraju igre.
a11y_knocked_out.en: %1$s is out. Roles are revealed at the end of the game.

out_count.note: Round header „7 u igri · 1 izbačen“ — mock uses gendered „izbačen“; neutral form proposed

spies_caught.note: Game over (citizens win). Mock „Oba špijuna su otkrivena.“ only covers 2. ‘špijun’ is grammatical gender of the noun, not of a player, so this is allowed.

review.issue: HR „Ako ga izbaciš … uloga mu se otkriva“ uses masculine pronouns (ga/mu) — breaks the design's own no-gendered-copy rule.
review.suggest_hr: Čekamo još %1$s. Ako ukloniš igrača, ide među izbačene — uloga se otkriva tek na kraju.

review.issue: Mock shows „Dodirni njegovu kartu.“ (gendered); the key already has the neutral „Dodirni kartu tog igrača.“ — use the key.
Mock text „…glasanje se otvara samo.“ differs from key „…otvara se glasanje.“ — key wins.
Mock shows ordinal „Čeka se treći igrač…“; key is „Čeka se igrač…“ — key wins (avoids ordinal agreement).
Phase-2 component board shows „Domaćin · povezan“ and „Glasala“ — superseded by lobby_connected „Na vezi“ and vote_cast; don't copy from that board.
Phase-1/2 boards say „Okreni i dodaj dalje“ / „Sakrij i sljedeći igrač“; final key is „Sakrij i dalje“ / last player „Sakrij i započni raspravu“.
Mock „party-pack.json · od Ane“ declines the sender's name (genitive) and the OS doesn't reliably give a sender — drop the sender, show only the file name.
Both are „%1$d od %2$d“ — fine, but don't reuse one for the other; different contexts in EN may diverge.

changelog.why: gender-neutral (later revision of the copy table)
